_comment: run_23a = run_21 (single field, occupied centring, absolute Allee, K level 3.0 +/- 1.0) plus:

(1) a FIRM prior on a WEAK absolute Allee effect: n50 median 0.03 route counts (was 0.127), n50_raw scale 0.25 (was 1.0), 90% within ~0.02-0.045. A front cell at 0.1 counts keeps ~90% of its fecundity (run_21's fitted n50 0.28 left ~22%).

(2) juvenile survival as a FRACTION of adult survival: Sj = Sa * sigmoid(alpha_j + s_j*H), so Sj < Sa at every habitat value; ratio prior median 0.5 (logit 0, sd 0.5). Journey survival Q is the same product on path habitat.

Why: every refined variant (run_19..22, the dispersal sweep) demands lambda0 ~ 2.2 at typical habitat, fitted as fecundity ~10 and juvenile survival ~0.93 > adult ~0.42. Constraining Sj alone may push that demand into fecundity -- watch Fmax. The temporal-habitat route (Z's 1950-1990 trend) is left open until the DESK work settles; when revisited it should be a LEARNED temporal weight.
